label: NDVI (MODIS vegetation greenness)
source: MODIS MOD13A1 + MYD13A1 v061 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: per-pixel monthly maximum of 16-day composites (Terra+Aqua, pixel reliability good/marginal), then mean of valid ~1 km cells in county
notes: Cloud-masked with pixel_reliability (0/1). Composites assigned to month of their mid-date.

label: EVI (MODIS enhanced vegetation index)
source: MODIS MOD13A1 + MYD13A1 v061 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: per-pixel monthly maximum of 16-day composites, then county mean

label: Land surface temperature, day (MODIS)
source: MODIS MOD11A2 v061 (Terra, ~10:30 local) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: per-pixel monthly mean of clear-sky 8-day composites, then county mean
notes: QC: mandatory QA good/other and LST error <= 2 K. Cloudy rainy-season months sample fewer pixels (clear-sky bias).

label: Land surface temperature, night (MODIS)
source: MODIS MOD11A2 v061 (Terra, ~22:30 local) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: per-pixel monthly mean of clear-sky 8-day composites, then county mean

label: Evapotranspiration, annual (MODIS)
source: MODIS MOD16A3GF v061 (gap-filled annual) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: mean of valid cells in county
notes: Planetary Computer only hosts the annual MOD16A3GF (no 8-day MOD16A2), so ET is annual (date = YYYY-07-01). Open water, urban and barren pixels are fill in MOD16 and excluded (e.g. permanent Sudd open water).

label: Surface reflectance, red (MODIS band 1)
source: MODIS MOD09A1 v061 (Terra) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: per-pixel monthly mean of clear 8-day composites, then county mean
notes: State QA: clear, no shadow, no/low cirrus, no internal cloud, not adjacent to cloud. 620-670 nm.

label: Surface reflectance, near-infrared (MODIS band 2)
source: MODIS MOD09A1 v061 (Terra) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: per-pixel monthly mean of clear 8-day composites, then county mean

label: Surface reflectance, shortwave infrared (MODIS band 6)
source: MODIS MOD09A1 v061 (Terra) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: per-pixel monthly mean of clear 8-day composites, then county mean
notes: 1628-1652 nm; sensitive to soil/vegetation moisture and burn scars. Same QA as red.
